messages:
Olga (Marketing): Quick post-webinar ops note: registration page had an incorrect UTM on the confirmation link. Need a patch and a re-send for registrants + clear lead routing.
Darren (Events): Ugh sorry, missed that. Which UTM?
Olga (Marketing): utm_campaign was 'webinar_march' but should be 'webinar_lowlatency_2026'. Fix on the redirect so clicks attribute correctly.
Felix (Growth): Also flag: we intended to only surface Calendly to 'engaged' viewers (watch_pct>=50). Make sure automation doesn't send Calendly to everyone.
Priya (Creative): Uploaded raw cloud recording from ZoomBot to drive: drive.redwood.ai/tmp/lowlatency_raw_2026.mp4. I'll make a 60s hero edit and captions. Where should I publish the edit?
Olga (Marketing): Put final assets in drive.redwood.ai/marketing/webinars/2026-lowlatency/ and add captions.srt. We'll use the 60s for LinkedIn and a 20s vertical for socials.
Nora (Sales): Lead rules: create contact for all registrants. Only convert to MQL if (watch_pct>=50 OR survey_interest=yes). Tag MQLs with 'webinar:lowlatency' and route to queue 'Inbound-Webinars'.
ZoomBot: Recording finished by host olga@redwood.ai 6 March 2026 14:30 UTC. Cloud link: https://zoom.us/rec/share/ZYX_example (passcode: rwd2026).
Darren (Events): I'll export attendee CSV with columns: email,name,company,join,leave,watch_pct,q&a_flag,chat_text and upload to the exports folder. Will run a quick PII scrub on chat_text before sharing.
Felix (Growth): Automation plan (short): watch CSV upload -> parse rows -> enrich via Clearbit (if available) -> create/update contact in HubSpot -> if watch_pct>=50 OR q&a_flag=true -> add to 'Inbound-Webinars' list and trigger Calendly webhook. Also add UTM correction step.
Olga (Marketing): Email copy drafts: Attendees: "Thanks for joining  Recording: {{recording_link_with_utm}}. Benchmark PDF: {{pdf_link_with_utm}}. If you watched >=50% we'll send a Calendly link to book a demo." Non-attendees: "Missed it? Catch the recording and join our office hours."
Priya (Creative): ETA for edits: 3 hours for hero + captions. I'll drop final files and a social schedule in this thread.
Nora (Sales): I'll prepare the CRM task template and conversion notes for SDRs. Template subject: "Webinar follow-up: Low-Latency".
Olga (Marketing): Thanks team. Darren, please fix the UTM on the registration redirect and re-trigger a confirmation email to registrants with corrected links. Felix, hold Calendly webhook until the watch_pct filter is in place. I'll close the loop when the assets are live. :white_check_mark:
